title: adonis annua subsp. castellana
intro: Adonis annua subsp. castellana, commonly known as Castilian Adonis or False Adonis, is a plant species in the genus Adonis. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is said to help in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Adonis annua subsp. castellana are attributed to its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit expectorant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
